Re-checking formula: Profit = Revenue - Variable Cost - Fixed Cost.
Produce only what can be sold: sold = min(Demand, capacity 900).
Produced = sold, variable = $9 per unit, fixed = $12,000.

- $19: sold = min(2601,900)=900. Revenue=19*900=17100. Variable=9*900=8100. Profit=17100-8100-12000 = -3000
- $24: sold = min(1157,900)=900. Revenue=24*900=21600. Variable=8100. Profit=21600-8100-12000 = 1500
- $29: sold = min(975,900)=900. Revenue=29*900=26100. Variable=8100. Profit=26100-8100-12000 = 6000
- $34: sold = min(173,900)=173. Revenue=34*173=5882. Variable=9*173=1557. Profit=5882-1557-12000 = -7675
- $39: sold = min(70,900)=70. Revenue=39*70=2730. Variable=9*70=630. Profit=2730-630-12000 = -9900

Highest is $29 at $6,000.
{"choice": "29", "value": 6000}
